item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukraine has used naval drones to strike Russian warships in Libya’s Benghazi port, and Ukraine says the attacks are lawful self-defence. Russia has violated Finnish airspace with a helicopter and Polish airspace with an unmanned aerial vehicle. A German warning says Russia is preparing to place a nuclear weapon in space within 60 days, prompting NATO to vow defence against a space threat. The UN Security Council warned that winter attacks on Ukraine’s power grid and Black Sea shipping threaten lives and global food supplies. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

The Israeli Defense Ministry reports over 31,500 troops have sought rehabilitation services since Oct. 7, and the IDF is probing 16 cases of soldiers using human shields in Gaza and the West Bank. Israeli forces continue to target Hamas infrastructure, and the conflict has caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

Hezbollah continues to expand its arsenal, as evidenced by reports of 14 interdicted arms shipments and an active supply route. Iran has ordered its Revolutionary Guards to leave Beirut strongholds, signaling a shift in regional involvement. item.description:
Iran has struck bases in Bahrain and set fire to an industrial facility there, while also launching missiles into the Strait of Hormuz. An athlete swam the length of the strait to draw attention to the environmental impact of the fighting, and a tracking site reported that a claimed Iranian tanker in the strait does not exist. Iran unveiled a dual-missile launcher and a new missile city, expanding its missile capabilities. Hakeem Jeffries pledged sanctions on violent West Bank settlers and an end to the Iran war. 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Yemen and the Red Sea: the situation
item.description:
Houthi forces have stepped up missile launches from Saada toward Aden, with projectiles landing in Dhamar and a strike on a civilian vehicle in Lahj that killed a child and injured three others, while a Houthi drone was intercepted by the Saudi-led coalition in the Red Sea. The coalition also intercepted another Houthi drone and a missile in western Yemen and hit a Houthi arms depot east of Taiz. The UK imposed sanctions on the Houthi group and four senior officials, and Saudi air strikes killed 17 people in a Yemeni city. Dozens of children have been killed in recent hostilities, and there were 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Syria: the situation
item.description:
US officials are weighing a military training and demining mission for Syrian forces, while a budget shortfall threatens the chemical weapons watchdog’s ability to continue work in Syria. Israeli forces raided southern Syria, wounding Syrian soldiers, and a drone strike in western Sweida injured four Syrian internal security personnel. In Damascus countryside, two Christian young men were found dead, and in Homs a church robbery led to the arrest of suspects, including a guard. A son of a Daesh leader was killed in Homs. 2,732 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Iraq: the situation
item.description:
The Iraqi prime minister has ordered the ministry to take direct control of oilfields in areas held by Kurdish parties, prompting the KDP and PUK to unite in opposition and warn Baghdad against unilateral decisions. Security forces have dismissed the border crossings chief and fired a border official, while new commanders have taken over Kirkuk operations and preparations are underway for a military withdrawal from certain cities. The government is also intensifying an anti-smuggling drive that targets Kurdish border crossings and oil theft, which has been reported across all governorates. 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Sudan's civil war: the situation
item.description:
Recent drone attacks near Khartoum have killed four people and damaged a United Nations building, while another strike hit residential areas and a second UN facility, threatening humanitarian operations. RSF forces have assaulted aid offices in Nyala and a shelter in West Kordofan, causing civilian casualties, and charity kitchens in Khartoum are closing, deepening hardship for displaced Sudanese. New defections include the RSF counterintelligence chief, a commander and a group joining the Sudanese army in Khartoum, indicating shifting loyalties within the conflict. The war produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: South Sudan: the situation
item.description:
Rebel and SPLA-IO forces have continued lethal attacks, killing civilians in Tonj East and Warrap State, including 24 civilians with children and women, and 15 civilians in an armed assault in Warrap. Cattle-theft raids have turned deadly, leaving more than 20 dead, and an abduction prompted MSF to suspend all activities in Yei River County. UNMISS is supporting efforts to deter further violence in Tonj East after intercommunal clashes, while the Juba Teaching Hospital director has called for more support for poor patients and a football referee shot in the head died in Juba hospital. According to UCDP, there were 2 battle-related deaths in 2024.

item.title: Somalia: the situation
item.description:

The United States carried out airstrikes against al-Shabaab at three sites in Somalia and President Museveni of Uganda met Somalia's President to discuss regional security and the AU peacekeeping transition, with the Ugandan army chief visiting Somali troops amid a withdrawal from Barawe. Somalia warned that unrest in Ethiopia could weaken security operations involving the African Union mission, and the conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
